decision.reason: [ev-98d8079a3380] says only that the deprecated `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag "has been removed in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout`". It does not say what happens when an environment still sets it: whether the value is silently ignored (setting-ignored) or the agent rejects the unknown flag and fails to start (workload-failure). The proposed statement ("will be ignored") and its high severity are guesses the excerpt doesn't support. We need the agent's flag-parsing behaviour for removed flags, or a changelog/PR excerpt that describes the effect.
